---
title: "Capital Gains Tax Reform in Canada: Lessons from Abroad"
date: "2014-11-07"
categories: ["Economics"]
---

The Fraser Institute has released a new [volume](http://www.fraserinstitute.org/research-news/display.aspx?id=21922) on international experience with capital gains taxes. I wrote the chapter on New Zealand, with some reference to Australia. Australia was deemed too similar to Canada to warrant a chapter in its own right.
